description:
Non-required nits and improvements surfaced by the code review of
explorer-heatmap-accessibility-and-tests.  Four Required issues
(broken CSS rule, invisible focus ring, empty columnheader, misleading
aria-sort) were fixed immediately post-review.  This item tracks
the remaining nit/consider findings.

anti_patterns.dont: change configureAxe to suppress impact levels globally
anti_patterns.instead: scope the config per-call or per-helper
anti_patterns.why: that silences violations in all tests

preserves.behavior: aria-label remains present on all cells in w1 - only the text format changes
axe helper continues to suppress minor violations - only the implementation mechanism changes in w2

verifications.description: QueryHeatmap axe tests still pass after axe-helper refactor
verifications.expected: all tests pass including axe assertions

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test

work_units.notes:
QueryHeatmap.tsx:278 - aria-label uses ms.toFixed(1) (e.g. "10.0 ms")
while the visible cell text uses fmtMs() which emits toFixed(0)
("10 ms").  Screen readers announce a value that differs from what
is displayed.

Fix: use fmtMs(ms) in the aria-label string for consistency.

Also: for the fastest cell (ratio=1.0), the label reads "10 ms, 1.0×
fastest in column" which is grammatically awkward - the cell IS the
fastest, not a comparison to it.  Special-case as "10 ms, fastest in
column" when ratio rounds to 1.0.
work_units.summary: Align aria-label text with visible cell text for timing values
Replace manual violation-split in axe-helper with configureAxe

work_units.notes:
QueryHeatmap.tsx:122-149 - handleCellKey handles ArrowLeft/Right/
Up/Down but not Home/End.  The WAI-ARIA 1.2 grid pattern recommends
(not requires) Home to jump to first cell in row and End to last cell
in row, Ctrl+Home to first cell in grid.

Low priority: not a WCAG requirement for read-only data grids.
Worth adding if AT user feedback surfaces the gap.
work_units.summary: Add Home/End key support to keyboard grid navigation

work_units.notes:
QueryHeatmap.test.tsx currently renders with no onSelectionChange, so
the checkbox column header (hasSelection=false) is never in the axe
DOM.  The Required fix (w3 in the main TODO) added aria-label to the
empty <th>, but there is no regression test that exercises the
selection path through axe.

Fix: add one axe test case in QueryHeatmap.test.tsx that passes
selectedIds={new Set()} and onSelectionChange={() => {}} so axe runs
against the full grid including the checkbox column header.
work_units.summary: Add axe test for QueryHeatmap with selection enabled
